name: STPI Srinagar Centre (Software Technology Parks of India)
developer: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
notes: STPI's Srinagar centre (about 10 km from Srinagar airport, 8 km from central Srinagar and 4 km from the Srinagar-Jammu national highway per STPI's Srinagar about page, which has since been renamed on the site) offers Data Center, incubation and related IT/ITeS services; the live STPI Srinagar page at stpi.in/about-srinagar lists Data Center Services and Incubation Services among its offerings, and the official STPI Srinagar Twitter account (@STPISrinagar, 'STPI Srinagar, Kashmir') confirms an operating centre. Government-run national-IT infrastructure presence in Srinagar district; MW capacity not applicable/disclosed.

name: J&K Near Data Centre (N-DRC) at Srinagar / J&K State Data Centre upgradation
developer: Jammu and Kashmir Information Technology Department / Jammu and Kashmir e-Governance Agency (JaKeGA)
notes: Kashmir Life (27 May 2025) reports, citing the J&K government's April 2025 assembly reply and Economic Survey 2025, that JaKeGA is establishing a near data centre in Srinagar parallel to the existing Jammu facility as part of an 'Upgradation of Data Centre for Jammu and Kashmir' project budgeted at Rs 124.66 crore; a near disaster recovery centre (N-DRC) within 10 km of the main State Data Centre and a remote DRC in a different seismic zone are also planned to make the SDC the unified government computing backbone. Project described as under implementation/tendering; no MW capacity disclosed.

Targeted searches for Samba district (Jammu region) with data centre/datacenter/server farm/hyperscale/colocation terms found only industrial-estate, weather and general district news; no public datacenter project or operating center is documented for Samba. J&K's data-centre activity is concentrated in Jammu (State Data Centre) and Srinagar (near data centre, STPI), per state and national coverage.

name: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad High Performance Computing Facility (HPC) / Campus Data Centre
notes: IIT(ISM) Dhanbad's official Research & Development brochure documents a High Performance Computing Facility built with Rs 10 crore of computing and software resources 'to cater growing and diversifying computing and data research needs'; the brochure's HPC listing describes a CPU-based cluster (50 nodes, 2,264 cores, 240 TB storage). Campus/institutional computing facility rather than a commercial colocation centre; no MW-scale commercial data centre project was found in Dhanbad district in public sources as of the check date.
